text:
sophie: Heads-up  invoice run bill-2026-06-10 created a duplicate for customer 'HarvestAI' (cust_3007). inv_238765A shows $15,200 but inv_238765B shows $13,980. The smaller invoice appears to have dropped a promotional discount line (-$1,220). Job id: run-9477, batch 3. @billing-team @jess :eyes:

billing-bot: retry handler created duplicate invoice inv_238765B after initial PDF generator timeout.

mark: quick DB check: ```SELECT id, amount_cents, line_items, metadata->>'job_id' FROM invoices WHERE customer_id='cust_3007' AND created_at > '2026-06-10';```
Result:
- inv_238765A | 1520000 | [{usage:1400000, promo_discount:-122000, tax:24000}] | job=run-9477
- inv_238765B | 1398000 | [{usage:1398000}]                        | job=run-9477-retry

jess: logs show billing-worker errored with "PDFWriteTimeout" then retry path created a new invoice row. The attach_promo() step checks `if promo_attached_for_job(job_id): return` and that returns true when job_id differs, so promo isn't reattached. File: billing/attach/promo.py:63. This is the inverse of what we expect.

sophie: Is payment captured? Client already asked about the lower amount. Don't send external note until we decide.

acct-bot: payments: inv_238765A captured=false, inv_238765B captured=false. No refunds needed.

mark: Proposed immediate actions: 1) pause exporter for run-9477; 2) void inv_238765B with note 'duplicate from retry: missing promo discount SPT-1810'; 3) reissue corrected invoice inv_238765C with full lines. Need accounting approval.

jess: I can open a quick PR to make attach_promo idempotent and add unique constraint on invoice_line(invoice_id, code). Also tweak retry to reuse invoice row when possible instead of creating a duplicate.

sophie: I approve the void (uncaptured). Please include support ticket SPT-1810 in the note and hold outbound messages until we've reissued.

mark: Draft SQL I'll run in 15m unless objections: ```UPDATE invoices SET status='voided', note='auto-duplicate: retry omitted promo discount; see SPT-1810' WHERE id='inv_238765B';```

engops: paused exporter for run-9477 and created ticket ENG-BILL-1002. Scheduling hotfix to staging in 30m.

jess: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/billing/pull/499  idempotent attach, unique constraint, and retry semantics fix. Adding test for promo attach on retry.

billing-bot: suppressed further automated retries for cust_3007 until patch is deployed.

sophie: please add audit log entry linking the void and PR. I'll draft the customer message after void: "Hi HarvestAI  we detected a billing automation error where a retry created a duplicate invoice that omitted a promotional discount. We will void the duplicate and issue a corrected invoice today. No action required on your side."

mark: running the void now and will set note to include SPT-1810 and the support link.

sophie: thanks all. tagging for month-end reconciliation and audit. :thumbsup:
